title: Migrant Crisis Reveals Vast Differences Between Ceuta and Its Moroccan Neighbor
summary: Ceuta, Spain, and Fnideq, Morocco, are physically separated by only a mile, but they are intertwined by family and trade. A recent border crisis is the latest chapter in their story.
